slime.name: Wasteland Slime
slime.description: A gelatinous blob that absorbs radiation. Weak but annoying.

scavenger.name: Scavenger Rat
scavenger.description: Mutated rodent with razor teeth. Fast and aggressive.

bandit.name: Road Bandit
bandit.description: A survivor who preys on travelers. Armed with a rusty rifle.

mech_drone.name: Patrol Drone
mech_drone.description: Pre-war security drone still guarding ruins. Fires laser beams.

desert_worm.name: Sand Worm
desert_worm.description: BOUNTY: Giant worm that swallows vehicles whole. Slow but devastating.

iron_titan.name: Iron Titan
iron_titan.description: BOUNTY: A walking fortress from the old war. Heavily armored, extremely dangerous.

mutant_bear.name: Mutant Bear
mutant_bear.description: A massive bear mutated by radiation. Frenzied and tough.
